import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Read the data
data = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Price vs Megapixels scatter plot
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
scatter = ax1.scatter(data['megapixels'], data['price_usd'], 
                     s=data['weight_grams']/5, c=data['model_year'], 
                     cmap='viridis', alpha=0.7, edgecolors='black', linewidth=1)
ax1.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_title('Price vs Megapixels\n(size=weight, color=year)', fontsize=11)
plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax1, label='Year')

# 2. Brand distribution
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
brand_counts = data['brand'].value_counts()
ax2.bar(brand_counts.index, brand_counts.values, color='steelblue', edgecolor='black')
ax2.set_xlabel('Brand', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_title('Camera Count by Brand', fontsize=11)
ax2.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 3. Sensor type distribution
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
sensor_counts = data['sensor_type'].value_counts()
colors = plt.cm.Set3(np.linspace(0, 1, len(sensor_counts)))
ax3.pie(sensor_counts.values, labels=sensor_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
        colors=colors, startangle=90)
ax3.set_title('Sensor Type Distribution', fontsize=11)

# 4. Body type distribution
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
body_counts = data['body_type'].value_counts()
ax4.barh(body_counts.index, body_counts.values, color='coral', edgecolor='black')
ax4.set_xlabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('Body Type', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_title('Body Type Distribution', fontsize=11)

# 5. 4K Video capability
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
video_counts = data['has_video_4k'].value_counts()
labels = ['No 4K', '4K']
ax5.bar(labels, [video_counts.get(0, 0), video_counts.get(1, 0)], 
        color=['#ff9999', '#66b3ff'], edgecolor='black')
ax5.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_title('4K Video Capability', fontsize=11)

# 6. Weight vs Price
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
brands = data['brand'].unique()
brand_colors = plt.cm.Set2(np.linspace(0, 1, len(brands)))
for i, brand in enumerate(brands):
    brand_data = data[data['brand'] == brand]
    ax6.scatter(brand_data['weight_grams'], brand_data['price_usd'], 
               label=brand, s=100, alpha=0.7, edgecolors='black', linewidth=1)
ax6.set_xlabel('Weight (grams)', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_title('Weight vs Price by Brand', fontsize=11)
ax6.legend(fontsize=8)

# 7. Max ISO comparison
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
ax7.scatter(range(len(data)), data['max_iso'], c=data['model_year'], 
           cmap='plasma', s=100, edgecolors='black', linewidth=1)
ax7.set_xlabel('Camera Index', fontsize=10)
ax7.set_ylabel('Max ISO', fontsize=10)
ax7.set_title('Max ISO by Camera\n(color=year)', fontsize=11)
ax7.set_yscale('log')

# 8. Year timeline
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
year_counts = data['model_year'].value_counts().sort_index()
ax8.plot(year_counts.index, year_counts.values, marker='o', linewidth=2, 
         markersize=8, color='darkgreen')
ax8.fill_between(year_counts.index, year_counts.values, alpha=0.3, color='lightgreen')
ax8.set_xlabel('Year', fontsize=10)
ax8.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax8.set_title('Cameras by Model Year', fontsize=11)
ax8.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 9. Price distribution
ax9 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
ax9.hist(data['price_usd'], bins=5, color='skyblue', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax9.set_xlabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax9.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=10)
ax9.set_title('Price Distribution', fontsize=11)
ax9.axvline(data['price_usd'].mean(), color='red', linestyle='--', 
            linewidth=2, label=f'Mean: ${data["price_usd"].mean():.2f}')
ax9.legend(fontsize=8)

plt.suptitle('Camera Dataset Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
